title: 第9章 必须得藏。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

感受到来自冯野审视的目光，司陇直接豁出去了。

“才刚醒，你进来对着我一通输出，我不能激动吗。”

意外的是冯野挑了下眉，移开视线，似乎接受了这个理由，也不甚在意司陇这略显不耐的语气。

难道自己赌对了？她们交流的模式竟然是这样的。

冯野双手插进制服口袋里，换了个随意的站姿，却给人一种无形的压迫感。

“连这种刚觉醒的新人都敢往你面前送，要么是人手不够，要么......就是知道了你消失一个月的事情，看你今天复工，来试试水。”

司陇的内心简直在崩溃的边缘反复横跳。

她消失一个月了又是什么意思，难道自己穿来之前这具身体发生了什么事？

她当然知道楚天为什么直奔自己而来，楚天跟自己一样都接了任务，可能他穿来的那个身份正好是黎明署的暗线杀手之一。

他穿来很快觉醒了异能，同时接了暗杀自己的任务，可能任务提示中的暗杀对象是个没有异能的废物，所以想也不想地就来了。

可这些她都不能说。

一旦泄露出去一点，她丝毫都不怀疑自己会被这个世界的科学家们如何研究，直到死。

“如果不是之前你失去了异能，这种级别的小崽子，连你的衣角都摸不到，何至于被一根合金矢钉穿。”

司陇震惊了。

她现在想的已经不是如何圆谎，而是冯野到底知道多少关于她这具身体的事情。

竟然连她的异能丧失都知道？

她真的很想直接问这一个月到底发生了什么，或者要不就装失忆？

可是她没有任何可以扯到失忆上的理由啊，想来想去自己还是只能硬着头皮继续演。

“结果是好的就行。”

冯野一副对她的反应了然于心的样子，不再纠缠于这个话题，抽出插在口袋里的手准备走了。

临走前又丢下一句。

“沿海路那个案子，本来是要交给你的，但看你现在的状态......”

“我没问题。”

沿海路的案子......这不就正好是她系统接的任务吗。

“行，但看你才刚从死神手中捡回一条命来，就不催你了。三天之内给我结果，不然我就交给别人。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Feeling the scrutinizing gaze from Feng Ye, Si Long gave in immediately.

"I just woke up. You come in and give me a blast. Can't I be excited?"

Surprisingly, Feng Ye raised his eyebrows and looked away, seemingly accepting this reason and not paying much attention to Si Long's slightly impatient tone.

Did you make the right bet?This is how they communicate.

Feng Ye put his hands into the pockets of his uniform and changed his stance to a casual posture, but it gave people an invisible sense of oppression.

"Even this newly awakened newcomer dares to send it to you. Either there are not enough manpower, or... I just know that you disappeared for a month. I hope you will resume work today and come to test the waters."

Si Long's heart was on the verge of collapse.

What does it mean that she disappeared for a month? Did something happen to this body before she came back?

Of course she knew why Chu Tian came straight to her. Chu Tian accepted the mission just like her. Maybe the identity he wore happened to be one of the secret killers of the Dawn Department.

He quickly awakened his superpower after traveling through it, and at the same time accepted the task of assassinating himself. Maybe the assassination target in the mission prompt was a waste without superpower, so he came here without thinking.

But she couldn't say any of this.

Once something leaked out, she had no doubt that she would be studied by scientists in this world until she died.

"If you hadn't lost your powers before, a brat of this level wouldn't even be able to touch the corners of your clothes, so why would you be nailed through by an alloy arrow?"

Si Long was shocked.

What she was thinking about now was not how to lie, but how much Feng Ye knew about her body.

He even knew about the loss of her powers?

She really wanted to ask directly what happened this month, or pretend to have amnesia?

But she didn't have any reason to blame her amnesia. After thinking about it, she had no choice but to bite the bullet and continue acting.

"As long as the result is good."

Feng Ye looked as if he understood her reaction and stopped dwelling on the topic. He took out his hand from his pocket and prepared to leave.

Before leaving, I left one more sentence.

"The case along the coastal road was originally supposed to be handed over to you, but looking at your current state..."

"I'm fine."

The case along the coastal road... wasn't this exactly the task her system took on?

"Okay, but since you just saved your life from the God of Death, I won't rush you. Give me the results within three days, otherwise I will hand it over to someone else."
